map.→ 打开库容曲线拟合工具: -> Open the storage capacity curve fitting tool
map.不同高程面积积分得分层库容支撑蓄供水计划。: Integrating area by elevation gives the storage capacity of each layer, supporting a water supply storage plan.
map.为什么用积分不直接乘？: Why use integration instead of multiplying directly?
map.库容曲线会变吗？: Does the storage capacity curve change over time?
map.库容曲线拟合用于水库调度图与兴利计算。: Storage capacity curve fitting is used for reservoir operation charts and benefit calculations.
map.库面随水位非线性变化，按高程分层梯形积分才贴合实际地形。: The water surface area varies non-linearly with level, so a layered trapezoidal integration by elevation is needed to match the actual terrain.
map.淤积使同水位对应面积减小、有效库容逐年下降，需定期复测更新。: Siltation reduces the area at a given level and the effective storage declines year by year, so periodic re-surveying and updating is needed.
map.淤积后重测面积曲线评估可用库容衰减。: Re-measure the area curve after siltation to assess the decay of usable storage capacity.
map.输入多组水位-面积数据，梯形法积分拟合水位-库容曲线，查询任意水位对应库容: Enter several water level and area data sets, integrate with the trapezoidal method to fit the level-capacity curve, and look up the storage at any level
map.：沿全高程分段积分累加得总库容，与已定死库容、调节库容分段核对。: : integrate by segments over the full elevation range and accumulate to get the total storage capacity, then check it against the dead storage and flood control storage segments.
map.：高程 112/115/118 m 对应面积 80/112/150 万㎡，层库容: : elevations of 112/115/118 m correspond to areas of 800,000/1,120,000/1,500,000 m2, so the layered storage is about (800,000+1,120,000)/2 x 3 + (1,120,000+1,500,000)/2 x 3, which is about 2.88 + 3.93 = 6.81 million m3.
